sourcePolicy: No supplied ZIP content or third-party art copied. Procedural Pillow drawings are original source art for this concept batch.
sourcePrompt: Original pixel-art secondary player family for a top-down ordinary-life simulator: warm olive complexion, auburn hair, mustard scarf, teal satchel, small gold star clip; preserve the cues while changing proportions from infant crawl through toddler, child, teen, young adult, midlife and elder woman/man. Four authored top-down directions, four readable walk phases, idle and reaching interaction, crisp 24x32 RGBA clusters, transparent background, no text, no logos, no mirror flips.
limitations: Concept quality only; small sprites require human pixel cleanup.
Identity continuity is structurally encoded but needs art-direction review before runtime.
All frames remain runtimeReady false until renderer integration and in-game review.
